title.narrative: Second Chittagong Hill Tracts Rural Development Project

description.narrative: The Project impact will be increased rural household incomes in CHT subproject areas. The outcome of the Project will be increased employment and income generating opportunities in subproject areas. There will be five main outputs: (i) institutional development and capacity building; (ii) rural roads and markets; and (iii) community infrastructure; (iv) micro agribusiness development (MAD); and (v) project management.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased income-generating opportunities for men and women in subproject areas

50% of market space to be developed under the project allocated for women Achievement: 50 Progress/Status: 23 market buiduings were constructed of which 8 in Rangamati, 8 in Khagrachari and 7 in Bandarban with 50% selling space has already been allocated for women. Data Source: Management information system project database within CHTRC, LGED and MOCHTA

Average time taken for women to fetch water is reduced from 1.5 hours 30 minutes Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: Data will be available after socioeconomic survey for the PCR. Data Source: Union parishad (elected council) and HDC records

Increased number of crops marketed from 2 to 10 in areas unconnected in 2010 Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: MAD-NGO covered 44 union of 9 upazilas of 3 hill districts. The activities were completed on 30 June 2019. Data will be available after socioeconomic survey for the PCR. Data Source: Department of Agriculture annual report

Increased HH commercial agricultural production from Tk20,000 per year in 2010 to Tk40,000 per year at 2010 price level Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Interventions completed in at least 600 villages. 200 in Rangamati, 201 in Khagrachari and 200 in Bandarban. Household income data will be available after socioeconomic survey for the PCR. Data Source: Project performance management system within CHTRC, LGED, and MOCHTA
Bangladesh Economic Review
Bureau of Statistics annual report

Reduced travel time to markets for women by on average 1 hour (2010 baseline = 4 hours) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Data will be available after socioeconomic survey for the PCR. Data Source: Project performance management system within CHTRC, LGED, and MOCHTA
Bangladesh Economic Review
Bureau of Statistics annual report
